I saw this video earlier and thought it was amazing. Despite his thick accent, he is a charismatic talker.

Zizek is certainly an interesting character. I've always thought of him as a philosophical grifter or charlatan, even after reading a few of his books. In this video he asserts that racism is wrong, that we should attempt to defeat it, and that we can defeat it, without justifying any of these assertions. The attempt is made to argue against PCness while relying on its own premises, which I would not ever attempt to do, but it may be a useful rhetorical tool.
